tests.title: Timecode format check CV02.5 at 33 1/3
tests.why: Confirms carrier frequency, phase and balance.
steps: Place vinyl on a turntable at 33, quartz lock, pitch 0.
Connect turntable to DVS interface line/phono per its setting.
Start the test and play the signal ~30 s.

tests.title: Carrier frequency
tests.why: Detects wrong format or wrong speed.
steps: As above.

tests.title: Quadrature phase 90 degrees
steps: As above.

tests.title: L/R amplitude balance
tests.why: Imbalance suggests cartridge fault or vinyl wear.
steps: As above.

tests.title: Carrier SNR
tests.why: Low SNR indicates wear, dirt or noise.
steps: As above.

tests.title: Dropouts
steps: Play the whole side or at least 2 minutes.

tests.title: 45 rpm behaviour
tests.why: Vinyl should be playable at 45; carrier scales with speed.
steps: Set turntable to 45 rpm and repeat.

tests.title: DVS signal integrity
steps: Play timecode on each deck.

tests.title: Vinyl side scan
tests.why: Walks the side to find worn/damaged zones and the lead-in.
steps: Place stylus at lead-in; let it play to the end; do not skip.

tests.title: Visual wear inspection
tests.why: Scratches, warp and dust cause dropouts.
steps: No deep scratches across the grooves.
Record is flat (no warp).
Clean with carbon fibre brush.
Time markers visible.
Label centre not loose.

tests.title: Serato calibration / threshold
tests.why: Calibrate for each deck to set noise threshold.
steps: Serato DJ Pro: Setup > DVS > Calibrate.
Adjust until the scope shows two clean circles and signal bars full.

tests.title: Absolute vs relative mode
tests.why: Absolute mode needs good lead-in position; relative ignores position.
steps: Switch ABS/REL/INT in Serato (with DVS).
Drop the needle in different places; ABS should jump to matching time.

tests.title: Serato DJ Pro installed
steps: Run check.

tests.title: Serato log errors
tests.why: Logs can show lost timecode or driver errors.
steps: Run check after a DVS session.
